author: claude
summary: Adds MobileModeSwitcher, a presentational persistent bottom tab bar for switching between ChapterEditor's mobile-eligible modes (Booth, Book view). Mirrors MobileNavDrawer's active-state signaling convention (aria-current on the active item, icon+label buttons) and DirectorsConsole's desktop rail role="tablist"/role="tab" semantics, but is a persistent bar rather than a modal overlay so it does not use useFocusTrap. Not yet wired into DirectorsConsole's render tree -- that is a later task, which will also do the mobile-eligible tool filtering and call useMediaQuery to decide when to render this instead of the desktop rail.

files.change: New presentational component: MobileModeSwitcherProps { tools: Array<{ id, label, icon: LucideIcon }>, activeToolId, onSelect }. Renders one role="tab" button per tools entry inside a role="tablist" container, aria-current/aria-selected reflecting activeToolId, onSelect(id) on click.

New .mobile-mode-switcher* rule set: sticky bottom bar with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding, flex items with 44x44px min touch targets, active-state tint matching .directors-console__rail-tab--active.
New test file: renders one tab per tool, aria-current/aria-selected reflect activeToolId, click calls onSelect with the right id, tablist has the expected accessible name.
